text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Mean absolute error of an XGBoost model given ENS's ensemble mean minus the same model given no weather at all, only the ENS arms' calendar and sun-geometry columns. All marks are post hoc: added after the first science review. Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from resampling whole months and a fitting seed. Capacity is each generator's 99th-percentile output. Six solar farms in Lincolnshire, every daylight hour, April 2024 to September 2026. Three wind farms in Lincolnshire, every hour, August 2024 to September 2026.'
